# Heron Market

A small storefront for a co-operative of print makers: browse the catalogue, add prints to
a cart, apply a coupon at checkout. Built with Vite, Vue 3 and Pinia, in the Feature-Sliced
layout; the [catalogue notes](docs/catalogue.md) explain the slices. The code is under
`src/`.

`src/components/` and `src/stores/` are from before the move to Feature-Sliced Design and
are retiring slice by slice.
